statement: The payment record contains a discrepancy between the employee name and the bank account holder, as well as a contradiction regarding when the account was last changed, which suggests a potential security risk or error.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the record itself is internally contradictory — "a discrepancy between the employee name and the bank account holder, as well as a contradiction regarding when the account was last changed" — naming the specific defect rather than merely urging verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
